html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap');
  /* Acme Stories, the company's media room, on one 76rem grid with ONE language: an Instrument Serif title per
     section, Instrument Sans for everything else, square-cornered pictures, sections numbered 01-05 on a hairline,
     one accent. The film always plays in a dark screening band. Moves: a customs stamp on the first picture, film
     frames around the stills in Cinema, the podcast cover turning like a record while it plays. Looks: Gallery
     (white walls and vermilion, follows light / dark), Cinema (black, amber, grain over the stills) and Archive
     (warm paper, sepia prints, brown ink). */
  #site-media {
    --background: oklch(0.99 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.18 0 0);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.96 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.44 0 0);
    --border: oklch(0.18 0 0 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.18 0 0 / 0.24);
    --primary: oklch(0.18 0 0);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0 0);
    --secondary: oklch(0.96 0 0);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.58 0.2 32);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.99 0 0);
    --ring: var(--md-brand);
    /* one corner for every box in the site - pictures, players, cards, buttons alike */
    --radius: 0.375rem;
    --radius-sm: var(--radius);
    --radius-md: var(--radius);
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: var(--radius);
    --md-title: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif;
    --md-stamp: oklch(0.5 0.16 255);
    --md-photo: saturate(1);
    color-scheme: light;
    container-type: inline-size;
    counter-reset: md;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.55 'Instrument Sans',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  .dark #site-media[data-look='gallery'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.17 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0 0);
    --card: oklch(0.21 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.24 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0 0);
    --border: oklch(0.95 0 0 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.95 0 0 / 0.24);
    --primary: oklch(0.95 0 0);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.17 0 0);
    --secondary: oklch(0.24 0 0);
    --accent: oklch(0.7 0.17 35);
    --md-stamp: oklch(0.75 0.12 255);
  }
  #site-media[data-look='cinema'] {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.12 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.94 0.01 85);
    --card: oklch(0.16 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.2 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0.01 85);
    --border: oklch(0.94 0.01 85 / 0.12);
    --input: oklch(0.94 0.01 85 / 0.24);
    --primary: oklch(0.82 0.13 80);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.12 0 0);
    --secondary: oklch(0.2 0 0);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.82 0.13 80);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.12 0 0);
    --md-stamp: oklch(0.82 0.13 80);
  }
  #site-media[data-look='archive'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.955 0.018 78);
    --foreground: oklch(0.26 0.03 50);
    --card: oklch(0.975 0.014 78);
    --muted: oklch(0.925 0.022 75);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.035 55);
    --border: oklch(0.26 0.03 50 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.26 0.03 50 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.36 0.06 45);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.975 0.014 78);
    --secondary: oklch(0.925 0.022 75);
    --secondary-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --accent: oklch(0.48 0.12 40);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.975 0.014 78);
    --md-stamp: oklch(0.45 0.12 30);
    --md-photo: sepia(0.55) saturate(0.8) contrast(1.02);
  }
  #site-media .md-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #site-media[data-look='cinema'] .md-look-only[data-for='cinema'] {
    display: block;
  }
  /* one grid for every section */
  #site-media > :not(template) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 76rem) / 2));
  }
  #site-media .md-bar {
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .md-bar .mk-header-inner {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #site-media .md-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem 1.5rem;
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  #site-media .md-nav a {
    padding-block: 0.375rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-media .md-nav a:hover,
  #site-media .md-nav a[aria-current] {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .md-brand {
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
    font: 400 1.625rem/1 var(--md-title);
  }
  #site-media .md-brand i {
    color: var(--md-brand);
  }
  #site-media .md-bar-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-media .md-bar .select {
    min-width: 8rem;
  }
  /* sections: a number on a hairline, then the content */
  #site-media > .md-section {
    counter-increment: md;
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  }
  #site-media > .md-section::before {
    content: counter(md, decimal-leading-zero);
    display: block;
    margin-block-end: 1.5rem;
    padding-block-start: 0.75rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--foreground);
    color: var(--md-brand);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }
  #site-media
    :is(.mk-text-media-title, .mk-media-gallery-head h2, .mk-video-player-caption h3, .mk-audio-player-title) {
    font-family: var(--md-title);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  #site-media img {
    filter: var(--md-photo);
  }
  /* the opening: copy beside the first picture, a customs stamp on it */
  #site-media .md-hero {
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);
  }
  #site-media .mk-text-media {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-media .mk-text-media-title {
    font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6.5vw, 5rem);
    line-height: 0.98;
  }
  #site-media .mk-text-media-text {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #site-media .mk-text-media-eyebrow {
    color: var(--md-brand);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-media .mk-text-media-media {
    position: relative;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  #site-media .mk-text-media-media img {
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
  #site-media .md-stamp {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    left: -1.75rem;
    bottom: -1.75rem;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 7.5rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    border: 3px double var(--md-stamp);
    border-radius: 50%;
    color: var(--md-stamp);
    background: var(--background);
    text-align: center;
    font:
      700 0.6875rem/1.2 'Instrument Sans',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    rotate: -12deg;
  }
  #site-media .md-stamp b {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.375rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  @container (width < 40rem) {
    #site-media .md-stamp {
      left: 0.75rem;
      bottom: -1.25rem;
      width: 6rem;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
  }
  /* photos: the grid, film frames in Cinema */
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-head h2 {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid figure {
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
  #site-media[data-look='cinema'] .mk-media-gallery-grid figure {
    padding: 0.85rem 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.93 0.02 85 / 0.85) 0 0.45rem, transparent 0.45rem 1.05rem) 0 0.2rem /
        100% 0.4rem no-repeat,
      repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.93 0.02 85 / 0.85) 0 0.45rem, transparent 0.45rem 1.05rem) 0
        calc(100% - 0.2rem) / 100% 0.4rem no-repeat,
      oklch(0.06 0 0);
  }
  #site-media[data-look='cinema'] .mk-media-gallery-grid img {
    filter: sepia(0.35) contrast(1.1) saturate(0.8);
  }
  #site-media .md-grain {
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
    opacity: 0.22;
  }
  /* the film: always in a dark screening band */
  #site-media > .md-film {
    color-scheme: dark;
    --background: oklch(0.14 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.95 0.005 85);
    --card: oklch(0.18 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.22 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.74 0.005 85);
    --border: oklch(0.95 0.005 85 / 0.14);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media > .md-film::before {
    border-color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .mk-video-player {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-media .mk-video-player-caption h3 {
    font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
  }
  /* listen: the player beside the episodes */
  #site-media .md-listen {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  @container (width > 56rem) {
    #site-media .md-listen {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
  }
  #site-media .md-listen::before {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    margin-block-end: 0 !important;
  }
  #site-media .mk-audio-player,
  #site-media .mk-playlist {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #site-media .mk-audio-player-cover {
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: md-spin 6s linear infinite paused;
  }
  #site-media .mk-audio-player:has(audio:not([paused])) .mk-audio-player-cover {
    animation-play-state: running;
  }
  @keyframes md-spin {
    to {
      rotate: 360deg;
    }
  }
  /* compare and share: the before / after beside what people posted */
  #site-media .md-pair {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  @container (width > 56rem) {
    #site-media .md-pair {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 2.5rem;
    }
  }
  #site-media .md-pair::before {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    margin-block-end: 0 !important;
  }
  #site-media .md-pair .mk-before-after {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-media .md-posts {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
  }
  #site-media .mk-social-post {
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  /* the opening's two calls to action */
  #site-media .md-cta {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.75rem;
  }
  /* Lisbon: every picture lifts and sharpens under the pointer, the others step back */
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid figure {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid img {
    transition:
      scale 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1),
      filter 0.4s;
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) img {
    scale: 1.07;
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid:has(a:is(:hover, :focus-visible)) a:not(:is(:hover, :focus-visible)) img {
    filter: var(--md-photo) saturate(0.35) brightness(0.8);
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid figcaption {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto 0 0;
    padding: 2.5rem 1rem 0.85rem;
    background: linear-gradient(transparent, oklch(0.1 0 0 / 0.7));
    color: oklch(0.98 0 0);
    font: 400 1.25rem/1.1 var(--md-title);
    translate: 0 100%;
    transition: translate 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1);
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) figcaption {
    translate: 0 0;
  }
  #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid a:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 3px;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
  /* a hovered episode: a quiet tint, never the accent */
  #site-media .mk-playlist-item label:hover {
    background: var(--muted);
  }
  /* the podcast: the cover beside the episode, the player as wide as its column */
  #site-media .mk-audio-player[data-variant='podcast'] {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-content: start;
  }
  #site-media .mk-audio-player[data-variant='podcast'] .mk-audio-player-cover {
    width: 8rem;
    height: 8rem;
  }
  #site-media .mk-audio-player-controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-media .mk-audio-player-controls audio {
    flex: 1 1 14rem;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #site-media .mk-audio-player-cover {
      animation: none;
    }
    #site-media .mk-media-gallery-grid :is(img, figcaption) {
      transition: none;
    }
  }
  /* light or dark: the Swap writes the page's dark class - every look has a light and a dark palette */
  #site-media .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #site-media [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* the playlist: the episode playing shows its bars */
  #site-media .mk-playlist-item label {
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  /* more stories: three cards, each a page */
  #site-media .md-stories-title {
    margin: 0 0 1.75rem;
    font: 400 clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem)/1.1 var(--md-title);
  }
  #site-media .md-story-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2rem 1.5rem;
  }
  #site-media .md-story {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #site-media .md-story img {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 10 / 7;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
  #site-media :is(.md-story-eyebrow) {
    margin-block-start: 0.5rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-media .md-story-title {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 1.5rem/1.2 var(--md-title);
  }
  #site-media .md-story-title a {
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-media .md-story-title a::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
  }
  #site-media .md-story:hover .md-story-title a {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
  }
  #site-media .md-story p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  /* a story's page: a reading column */
  #site-media > [data-media-view='story'] {
    padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem) clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  }
  #site-media .md-page {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1.25rem;
    max-width: 48rem;
    margin-inline: auto;
  }
  #site-media .md-back {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    width: fit-content;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-media .md-back:hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .md-back svg {
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
  }
  #site-media .md-page-title {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem)/1.05 var(--md-title);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #site-media .md-page-lead {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #site-media .md-page-photo {
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
  }
  #site-media .md-page-photo img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 2 / 1;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius);
  }
  #site-media .md-page-body {
    display: grid;
    gap: 1rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #site-media .md-page-body p {
    margin: 0;
  }
  #site-media .md-pager {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-block-start: 2rem;
    padding-block-start: 1.5rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .md-pager a {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-media .md-pager a + a {
    text-align: end;
  }
  #site-media .md-pager span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-media .md-pager strong {
    font: 400 1.375rem/1.2 var(--md-title);
  }
  #site-media .md-pager a:hover strong {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
  }
  /* the footer: the Site Footer block under a hairline */
  #site-media .md-footer {
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--foreground);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #site-media .md-footer .mk-footer-inner {
    max-width: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) 0 2rem;
  }
  @container (width > 48rem) {
    #site-media .md-footer .mk-footer-top {
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.6fr);
      gap: 4rem;
    }
  }
  #site-media .md-footer .mk-footer-brand-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font: 400 1.75rem/1 var(--md-title);
  }
  #site-media .md-footer .mk-footer-brand-name i {
    color: var(--md-brand);
  }
  #site-media .md-footer .mk-footer-heading {
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #site-media .md-footer :is(.mk-footer-list a, .mk-footer-social a) {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #site-media .md-footer :is(.mk-footer-list a, .mk-footer-social a):hover {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* -- modes: each look in light and dark, derived from the palettes above (the other mode of each look) -- */
  :root:not(.dark) #site-media[data-look='gallery'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.945 0.045 32);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.18 0 0);
  }
  .dark #site-media[data-look='gallery'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.26 0.05 35);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.95 0 0);
  }
  .dark #site-media[data-look='cinema'] {
    --accent: oklch(0.24 0.05 80);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.94 0.01 85);
  }
  :root:not(.dark) #site-media[data-look='cinema'] {
    color-scheme: light;
    --background: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.01 85);
    --card: oklch(0.997 0 0);
    --card-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.01 85);
    --muted: oklch(0.95 0 0);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.01 85);
    --border: oklch(0.2 0.01 85 / 0.12);
